messages:
lina: quick design check: updated encryption + region modal for the retention workflow. small accessibility + compliance nits please.

omar: saw it. Two immediate concerns: the modal shows a compact explanation for BYOK that users miss. Need an explicit "Requires KMS admin" callout.

kelly: a11y: when the explainer expands the focus currently jumps to the top of the page. It should trap in the modal and focus the expanded content. Use aria-expanded and focus management.

rui: compliance copy: avoid saying 'exportable' as a promise. propose: "Export depends on your KMS configuration and policy." Short and safe.

lina: suggested microcopy:
```
Redwood-managed (recommended): we store and rotate keys. Key material cannot be exported by Redwood.
Customer-managed (BYOK): use your KMS. Export and rotation depend on your KMS policy. Requires KMS admin.
```

omar: audit note: any change to KMS or region must generate an audit entry. suggestion: event id `security.kms.update.v1` and human message "{user} set KMS to {selection} for org {org}". Also alias previous id `security.kms.change` for 3 months.

kelly: keyboard flow idea: first tabbable element = KMS radio group, next = expand/collapse explainer (aria-controls), then region select, then primary Save. Escape behavior: if there are unsaved changes show a confirmation dialog.

rui: UX nit: the region default reads as "US (default)" 12; users in EU asked to see full country name rather than code. Change label to "Processing region (default: United States)". Also add tooltip: "Selecting a region may affect features and compliance."

lina: visuals: make BYOK chip use `--color-warning-600` bg and `--color-on-warning` for text to meet contrast. Avoid tiny badges; use a small chip with icon.

audit-bot: reminder: audit schema v2 rollout happening this quarter. Keep machine id stable during alias period.

omar: good. I'll update figma and add the KMS admin chip. lina will add the safe copy and aria notes. kelly, can you add the keyboard prototype?

kelly: yes, will attach a small keyboard demo in ~45m.

lina: action items consolidated: 1) adopt rui's safe export wording, 2) change region label to full name, 3) ensure aria-expanded + focus trap, 4) BYOK chip color + text, 5) emit audit event + alias plan. will post PR when ready. :thumbsup:
